records.title_en: Intercontinental Exchange Reports September and Third Quarter 2026 Statistics
records.title_cn: Intercontinental Exchange（ICE）公布2026年9月及第三季度交易统计
records.summary_en: ICE reported September 2026 average daily volume (ADV) growth of 51% year-over-year overall, 26% in Energy, 81% in Financials and 95% in Interest Rates. For Q3 2026, total ADV rose 31% year-over-year, with Financials up 45% and Interest Rates up 49%.
records.summary_cn: ICE公布2026年9月日均成交量（ADV）：整体同比增长51%，能源业务增长26%，金融业务增长81%，利率业务增长95%。2026年第三季度，整体ADV同比增长31%，其中金融业务增长45%，利率业务增长49%。
records.business_relevance: Interest-rate derivatives competition with Eurex; energy-market competition with EEX.
records.official_title: Intercontinental Exchange Reports September and Third Quarter 2026 Statistics

source_verification.official_title: Intercontinental Exchange Reports September and Third Quarter 2026 Statistics
notes: September figures are year-over-year: overall 51%, Energy 26%, Financials 81%, Interest Rates 95%.
Q3 year-over-year ADV: overall 31%, Financials 45%, Interest Rates 49%.

records.title_en: ICE Launches New VLCC Tanker and Container Freight Contracts as Customers Hedge Freight Risk Across Global Trade Routes
records.title_cn: ICE推出VLCC油轮及集装箱运费合约，支持全球贸易航线运费风险对冲
records.summary_en: ICE launched cash-settled VLCC tanker freight futures for TD34 (Gulf of Oman to China) and TD15 (West Africa to China), based on Baltic Exchange assessments, plus cash-settled container freight average price options for Asia-North Europe and Asia-U.S. West Coast, indexed to NYSHEX freight indices. ADV across its freight markets is up 33% year-to-date.
records.summary_cn: ICE推出现金结算的VLCC油轮运费期货，覆盖TD34（阿曼湾至中国）和TD15（西非至中国）航线，并依据Baltic Exchange价格评估结算；同时推出亚洲至北欧、亚洲至美国西海岸航线的现金结算集装箱运费平均价格期权，挂钩NYSHEX运费指数。其运费市场ADV年初至今增长33%。
records.business_relevance: Freight and commodity derivatives product expansion relevant to EEX competition.
records.official_title: ICE Launches New VLCC Tanker and Container Freight Contracts as Customers Hedge Freight Risk Across Global Trade Routes

source_verification.official_title: ICE Launches New VLCC Tanker and Container Freight Contracts as Customers Hedge Freight Risk Across Global Trade Routes
notes: Official release is dated October 5, 2026 and describes products launched that day.
TD34 and TD15 tanker futures use Baltic Exchange assessments; container options use NYSHEX freight indices.
33% is freight-market ADV year-to-date, not overall ICE volume or September-only growth.

records.title_en: CME Group's International Average Daily Volume Rises 22% to 9 Million Contracts in Q3 2026
records.title_cn: CME Group第三季度国际日均成交量同比增长22%，达到900万份合约
records.summary_en: CME Group reported Q3 2026 international average daily volume (ADV), covering trading outside the United States, of 9 million contracts, up 22% year-over-year. EMEA ADV was 6.5 million contracts, up 20%, and APAC ADV was 2.1 million, up 28%, year-over-year. Global Q3 ADV was separately reported at 29.4 million contracts, up 16% year-over-year.
records.summary_cn: CME Group公布2026年第三季度国际日均成交量（ADV，即美国境外交易）：900万份合约，同比增长22%。欧洲、中东及非洲（EMEA）ADV为650万份合约，同比增长20%；亚太（APAC）为210万份，同比增长28%。另行公布的全球第三季度ADV为2940万份合约，同比增长16%。
records.business_relevance: International derivatives market growth and regional competitive positioning against Eurex.
records.source_name: 芝加哥商品交易所集团
records.official_title: CME Group's International Average Daily Volume Rises 22% to 9 Million Contracts in Q3 2026

source_verification.official_title: CME Group's International Average Daily Volume Rises 22% to 9 Million Contracts in Q3 2026
notes: International means outside the United States: 9 million contracts, +22% year-over-year.
EMEA 6.5 million/+20%; APAC 2.1 million/+28%; global 29.4 million/+16%, all Q3 2026.

records.title_en: MSCI Launches SignalLab Giving Investment Teams Access to Trusted and Integrated Signals
records.title_cn: MSCI推出SignalLab，为投资团队提供可信且整合的研究信号
records.summary_en: MSCI launched SignalLab, an investment research and signal analytics platform with more than 600 research-grade signals spanning Risk Premia, Micro-Industries, FactorLab and Crowding. AI supports research workflows, with human validation and methodological governance. Additional modules are planned; the platform helps teams test and deploy signals rather than making investment decisions on their behalf.
records.summary_cn: MSCI推出投资研究与信号分析平台SignalLab，提供逾600项研究级信号，涵盖风险溢价（Risk Premia）、微行业（Micro-Industries）、FactorLab及拥挤度（Crowding）。平台在研究流程中使用AI，并保留人工验证及方法论治理。新增模块仍处于规划阶段；平台帮助团队测试和应用信号，并非代替客户作出投资决策。
records.business_relevance: Research signals, index/risk analytics and AI workflows relevant to ISS STOXX and investment-management solutions.
records.official_title: MSCI Launches SignalLab Giving Investment Teams Access to Trusted and Integrated Signals

source_verification.official_title: MSCI Launches SignalLab Giving Investment Teams Access to Trusted and Integrated Signals
notes: More than 600 signals; Risk Premia, Micro-Industries, FactorLab and Crowding are current areas.
Research/model-validation teams validate AI-generated work; Fundamental Momentum and AI Exposure Intelligence are future modules.
